source_data.title: Moving Mountains
source_data.body:
In Luke 11:1, the disciples asked Jesus, "Teach us to pray!" Most of us want to know more about how prayer works. While we are used to offering up prayers, we wonder if we are praying in the most effective way or if we are approaching the throne of God in the "right" way. We ask ourselves:
How do I listen for God?
How do I pray for healing?
How do I pray when I am under spiritual attack?
How do I pray to break through strongholds of habitual sin?
How do I pray for protection?
How do I pray for my lost friends and family?
In this Moving Mountains DVD Study, John Eldredge shows how we labor under the misconception that prayer is asking God to intervene instead of partnering with him to get things done. This faulty assumption leads to untold confusion and grief when we ask of God but can't sense He hears us--or even cares. Rather, Jesus says, "I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven; whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven" (Matthew 16:19). When we operate from this position, we approach prayer with far greater confidence. We understand we have a role in making change happen and are not victims of circumstance--that we are sons and daughters of God bestowed with tremendous authority.
Group Discussion Questions

source_data.title: All Things New - FB Live Book Study
source_data.body:
Recorded during a Facebook LIVE video study of John's new book All Things New.  Each week offers a deeper look at a couple of chapters from the book along with the Q&A that occured after each teaching.
 
More about the book: This is a revolutionary book about our future based on the simple idea that heaven is not our eternal home-the New Earth is. Most Christians (most people for that matter) do not really look forward to their future because their views of heaven are vague, religious, and appallingly boring. Hope begins to surge when we understand that for the believer nothing is lost. Heaven is not a life in the clouds; it is not unending worship singing. Rather, the life we long for, the paradise Adam and Eve knew, is precisely the life that is coming to us. And coming soon.

source_data.title: Battle to Fight - Spiritual Warfare for Men
source_data.body: Ask the men you know to name their favorite movies. Nine times out of ten, they will be stories of great battles, fought against desperate odds. Watch little boys at play. They nearly always wind up acting as the Hero in the midst of great battles. God set this desire in the heart of every man because we live in a world at war. An epic struggle of good and evil that began before the dawn of time, and learning how to fight in this battle is essential. Recorded live at our Wild at Heart Boot Camp, you'll hear John Eldredge teach on the role of spiritual warfare in our lives, how to identify it, and most importantly, how to battle and win against our adversary!

source_data.title: Epic: The Larger Story
source_data.body: In Epic: The Larger Story, John Eldredge suggests that life, for most of us, feels like a movie we've arrived to forty minutes late. We find ourselves in the middle of a story that is sometimes wonderful, sometimes awful, but usually a confusing mixture of both. And, we haven't a clue how to make sense of it all.  No wonder we keep losing heart. We need to know the rest of the story. Ours is a great story that began before the dawn of time. A story of adventure, risk, loss, heroism, and betrayal. This audio teaching is the Gospel like you've never heard it before. There is a Larger Story. And you have an irreplaceable role to play.

source_data.body: Eve wasn’t created as an afterthought, but as the pinnacle of all creation. Tragically, she chose to disobey God and distrust his heart. And still today, this deep distrust of God plays out in our lives. Women tend to express their “fallenness” on a spectrum varying between controlling and desolate. Through two full-length messages, Lori McConnell and Lisa Beck each share personal stories and reveal the path from fallenness to redemption, so you can become the woman God fully intends you to be.

This is why Jesus invites his disciples to..."follow me". In this extended conversation, John Eldredge and Craig McConnell share what it means to follow—and to lead—well. source_data.title: Four Streams
source_data.body: If you look at the ways in which Christ engages others, you’ll notice he offers his life in the areas covered in this 4-part teaching on the Four Streams: Discipleship (Walking with God), Warfare (Spiritual Warfare), Counseling (Receiving God’s Intimate Counsel), and Healing (Deep Restoration). Christ wants to do more for us than simply forgive. He wants to restore us. Look at the miracles He did: The blind saw, the lame walked, the dead were raised to life. Through these miraculous stories, Christ was trying to show us something. Look! This is what I want to do for you! I want to restore you. Listen to this life changing message as John teaches on each stream, as well as providing practical application.

source_data.title: Hope of Prayer
source_data.body: The Scriptures talk a lot about prayer, but we’re not really sure what to do with it, or, more importantly, how to do it. At least, how to do it in a way that works and actually brings about change. But that’s what prayer is supposed to do! Bring about change. And when Jesus teaches us to pray “Thy Kingdom come, thy will be done,” he means precisely that—that our prayers, somehow, enable the Kingdom of God to come and his will to be done “on earth as it is in heaven.” Meaning, here, now, in our lives. In this 8-part series, John Eldredge teaches how to pray with hope and confidence.

dest_data.title: Hope of Prayer
dest_data.subtitle: Scriptures teach us to pray to bring about change, but we don't know how. John Eldredge teaches how to pray with hope and confidence in an 8-part series.

source_data.title: Hoping in the Coming Kingdom
source_data.body: Hope is for our soul as breathing is to our body—we cannot live without it. Hope is how we thrive. Paul even says that our faith and love spring from the hope we have in the coming Kingdom of God (Colossians 1:5). And yet, very few people actually think about the promised life that is coming to us. Our thoughts about "heaven" are so bland and boring, no wonder we aren't bursting with hope! In this powerful five-session series, John and Stasi Eldredge explore the beauty of the Kingdom of God that will soon be ours. Your heart will be filled with renewed hope and your spirit will soar at the sheer joy of it! But be warned. This isn't a series for passive listening…it's one you'll want to keep a journal handy and actively enter into. Through the sessions, John and Stasi invite you into times of prayer and introspection that will fill your heart with awe and anchor your hopes in the coming Kingdom.

dest_data.title: Hoping in the Coming Kingdom
dest_data.subtitle: Hope is essential to our lives, and the Kingdom of God is a source of hope and joy. John and Stasi Eldredge explore the beauty of the Kingdom in this five-session series, inviting listeners to actively engage with prayer and introspection to fill their hearts with awe and anchor their hopes.

source_data.title: How Not To Lose Heart
source_data.body: In 2 Corinthians 4:1, Paul says "Therefore, we do not lose heart". But, how do we keep from losing heart? How do we live with disappointment and still find real joy? In this conversation, John Eldredge, Craig McConnell, and Bart Hansen talk openly about the things they face that tempt them to lose heart and how God is helping them to discover what Paul knew—how not to lose heart. More than that, how to live with a heart that is alive and free.

dest_data.title: How Not To Lose Heart
dest_data.subtitle: Paul encourages us to not lose heart, but how? John, Craig and Bart discuss how to stay strong in the face of disappointment and find joy, and how God helps us to keep our hearts alive and free.

source_data.title: Life of Jesus
source_data.body: To know Jesus is to love Him. To know Jesus is to believe. What you think about Jesus will frame your understanding of just about everything else—your understanding of God, and what it means to be a human being, it will affect your prayer life and intimacy with God. Come and take a fresh look as John teaches on Jesus' sense of humor, his kindness, his cunning, his anger, his tenderness and his playfulness. In this series, you are going to get a glimpse of the most remarkable person you have ever met.

dest_data.title: Life of Jesus
dest_data.subtitle: Knowing Jesus is to love Him, believe in Him, and understand Him. His sense of humor, kindness, cunning, anger, tenderness, and playfulness will be revealed in this series, giving you a glimpse of the most remarkable person you have ever met.

source_data.title: Love & War - Audio Book
source_data.body:
Unabridged Audio Book Read by John & Stasi Eldredge!! (Approx  7.5 hours)
John and Stasi's book, Love and War: Finding the Marriage You've Dreamed Of does for couples what Captivating did for women and Wild at Heart did for men. With refreshing openness that will grab readers from the first page, the Eldredges candidly discuss their own marriage and the insights they've gained from the challenges they have faced. Each talks independently to the reader about what they've learned, giving their guidance personal immediacy and a balance between the male and female perspectives that has been absent from all previous books on this topic.
John and Stasi begin Love & War with an obvious but necessary acknowledgement: Marriage is fabulously hard. They believe we need to get past the shame and confusion surrounding the undertaking of marriage before we can truly deal with our day-to-day situations.
Love & War shows couples how to fight for their love and happiness, calling on both men and women to step into the great adventure God has waiting for them together. Walking alongside John and Stasi Eldredge, every couple can discover how their journey together is growing into a story of meaning much greater than anything they could do or be on their own.

dest_data.title: Love & War - Audio Book
dest_data.subtitle: John & Stasi Eldredge share their journey of marriage, offering insight & guidance to couples on how to fight for their love & happiness & discover a story of meaning together.

source_data.title: Loving Men
source_data.body: Every woman has men in her life—a father, husband, brother, son or even co-workers. And often, problems enter into these relationships simply from not understanding their hearts, thoughts and desires. In this special two-disc collection, Lori McConnell first shares how to love men from a feminine perspective (with her husband Craig responding). Then, Morgan Snyder takes a looks at this topic from a masculine point of view (with his wife Cherie responding). Through personal stories and candid discussion, women will discover how to care for the hearts of men by reflecting the heart of God.

dest_data.title: Loving Men
dest_data.subtitle: Women learn how to love men from both a feminine and masculine perspective, with personal stories and discussion to help them understand and care for the hearts of men in a way that reflects God's heart.

source_data.title: Major & Minor Themes
source_data.body: This conversation with Wild at Heart is about the place of suffering and breakthrough in our lives. Both can be found in Scripture, and both have a place in our lives. Yet one is to be the major theme in our story, the other a minor theme. Sadly, in our post-modern culture, the minor theme has become the major theme. It feels much safer to talk about our suffering than it does to talk about breakthrough. We aren’t saying that all suffering can be ended in this life, but we will never know how much can be until we stop hopelessly yielding to things as they are. We must look to God for Life—and the breakthrough that comes as a result.

dest_data.title: Major & Minor Themes
dest_data.subtitle: Suffering and breakthrough both have a place in our lives, but in our culture, suffering has become the major theme. We must look to God for Life and the breakthrough that comes with it, instead of hopelessly yielding to things as they are.

source_data.title: Men Talking About Women
source_data.body: This four-part series begins with a live talk that John Eldredge gives at our Boot Camp event called “Rescuing the Beauty.” Then John brings the Wild at Heart men's team into the studio to offer some personal stories and illustrations to help further unpack that session. In the third part of the series, John shares on sexual healing and wholeness, including a powerful guided time of healing prayer. Finally, the guys head back into the studio to offer some very honest and hopeful stories from their journeys. We’ve wanted to speak to men candidly about issues men wrestle with when it comes to women, beauty, and sexuality. But how to approach the subject in a way both honest and helpful? We think we've done it.

dest_data.title: Men Talking About Women
dest_data.subtitle: John Eldredge speaks on beauty, sexuality, and relationships in a 4-part series, with personal stories and illustrations, healing prayer, and honest, hopeful stories from the men's journeys.

source_data.title: New Name
source_data.body: Join Craig McConnell and John Eldrege in this live teaching and conversation as they explore how to begin to see ourselves as God sees us, and how to embrace all that Christ has accomplished for us. As we look at this, we can begin to believe and experience a new identity—a new name, and a reorientation of who we truly are. With that, we can better find our place in God's Larger Story.

dest_data.title: New Name
dest_data.subtitle: Craig & John explore how to see ourselves as God does & embrace Christ's accomplishments, leading to a new identity & place in God's Story.

dest_data.title: Platinum Collection - Audio Boot Camp Series

source_data.title: Raising Boys
source_data.body: 1 Corinthians 16:13 says, "Stand firm in the faith; be men of courage; be strong." To be a man is a very powerful thing. How to become a man is something most people know little about. There is a journey a boy goes through from boyhood to young manhood. The team shares their experiences in growing up as boys with two purposes in mind: to help men "fill in the holes" in their masculine journey and to help our listeners be more intentional about raising boys into men.

dest_data.title: Raising Boys
dest_data.subtitle: Be strong in faith, courageous, and intentional in raising boys to become men; fill in the holes in the masculine journey.

source_data.title: Raising Girls
source_data.body: Raising Girls takes us into a world of twirling skirts, pretty shoes and tea parties. This conversation explores the heart of a little girl from personal stories and from the perspective of parenting—what she wants, what she needs, and what makes her heart come alive as she asks the questions, “Do you see me? Am I lovely?” The stories shared are of brokenness and redemption, heartache and delight, and the beauty that emerges when the feminine heart knows she is truly and deeply loved.

dest_data.title: Raising Girls
dest_data.subtitle: A journey of discovery into the heart of a little girl, exploring her wants, needs and joys, and the beauty of being deeply loved.

source_data.title: Relational Freedom - The Joy of Connecting
source_data.body: We are relational to the core. Yet it's impossible for us to be fully present to those around us if we neglect our own soul. In this extended conversation (taken from a 10-part podcast series), John Eldredge and Craig McConnell discuss the importance of loving well and connecting with others. They discuss three styles of relating (moving towards, moving against, moving away), how to avoid relational sabotage, the power of forgiveness and the difference between loving an evil person and loving a fool. Most of all, you'll discover the power of your presence—and the joy of true community—found only through Relational Freedom.
source_data.book_parent_title: Relational Freedom - The Joy of Connecting

dest_data.title: Relational Freedom - The Joy of Connecting
dest_data.subtitle: Loving well and connecting with others is key to relational freedom, which brings joy and true community. Three styles of relating, avoiding sabotage, forgiving, and loving both evil and foolish people are discussed to help us be present to those around us.

source_data.title: Sonship: Receiving God as Father
source_data.body: Do you know God as a generous, strong, and intimate Father? That is your destiny. Because God's desire is for us to walk in the strength and dignity of our inheritance as sons of God. In this transforming teaching, Morgan Snyder illuminates one of the central invitations of the Gospel—to forsake independence and fatherlessness. To receive God as Father. And to become the son we were intended to be.

dest_data.title: Sonship: Receiving God as Father
dest_data.subtitle: God desires us to accept Him as Father and become the sons/daughters we were meant to be, so we can live with strength and dignity as heirs of His love.

source_data.title: Stages of the Masculine Journey Live
source_data.body: How does a man become a man and know that he is one? For centuries, boys and men followed a process of masculine initiation, a journey God put in the heart of every boy. But we lost that, about the same time we lost a father-centered view of the world. Most men, and most boys growing up these days, have no man to guide them in their journey to become a man. But there is hope. Join John Eldredge as he reveals how God comes to a man as Father, and invites him on a journey of masculine initiation.  John walks through the stages of the journey—from Boyhood to the Cowboy, the Warrior, the Lover, the King, the Sage—and shows us how we can offer this to our sons as well.
source_data.book_parent_title: Stages of the Masculine Journey Live

dest_data.title: Stages of the Masculine Journey Live
dest_data.subtitle: Boys and men have lost the process of masculine initiation, but John Eldredge reveals how God can guide them on a journey to become a man. He walks through the stages of the journey, from Boyhood to Cowboy, Warrior, Lover, King, and Sage, and shows how to offer this to sons.

source_data.title: The Utter Relief of Holiness - Live
source_data.body: When we discover what the salvation of Jesus Christ means for our own restoration, we'll find that holiness is an expression of the healing of our humanity. What a relief it would be to be set free from all that plagues us: the inner struggle with anger or contempt, the struggle with habitual sins. There is good news! We can be set free through the healing work of Christ in our lives and be made more whole. In this four-part series, John Eldredge explores the beauty of the genuine goodness available to us in Jesus Christ and guides us through the process whereby God makes us whole and holy by his love. You will be relieved. Utterly.
source_data.book_parent_title: The Utter Relief of Holiness - Live

dest_data.title: The Utter Relief of Holiness - Live
dest_data.subtitle: Jesus Christ offers us healing & freedom from our struggles, sins & inner turmoil. Through His love, God makes us whole & holy, bringing us relief & genuine goodness. John Eldredge guides us through this process in a 4-part series.

source_data.title: Work of Christ
source_data.body: There is far more to the Christian life than just forgiveness, and there's far more to the work of Christ than the Cross. Yes, Jesus came to die for us—an act of love unparalleled in the history of the world. But, Jesus also rose from the dead. And the power of His resurrection is what most people are missing in their lives. The power of real Life, restoration and healing. The power to live as we were meant to live. And there is more...Christ also ascended to the throne. All authority in heaven and earth is His, and He has shared it with us. That's how we triumph over the Enemy. Come and discover the power of the full work of Christ. The power to restore you, as a woman or a man whose life is filled with the radiance of God.

dest_data.title: Work of Christ
dest_data.subtitle: Jesus died for us, rose from the dead, and ascended to the throne, granting us authority to triumph over the Enemy. Discover the power of the full work of Christ to restore you and your life with God's radiance.

source_data.title: Restoration of the Heart Conference - AUDIO
source_data.body:
Join friends and comrades John Eldredge and Dan Allender for a live audio recording of a dynamic, two-day conference for men and women filled with wisdom for healing the soul.
With nearly 60 years of collective experience engaging the core wars of the heart, John and Dan will bring to life the ways in which understanding your story and accessing the presence of Jesus can provide an unparalleled opportunity for lasting change. Restoration of the Heart is an experience for those who are seeking restoration, and those who help bring it to others.

source_data.title: Unwavering: Living With Defiant Joy
source_data.body:
In this six-week video study, Unwavering, Stasi Eldredge draws powerful lessons from her book, Defiant Joy, to help us defy, resist, and oppose the powers that threaten to destroy our souls and steal our joy.
Throughout this study, Stasi teaches us how to remain unwavering in the face of numbing loneliness, unexpected crisis, gripping fear, desolate waiting, sad endings, and hurtful offense. God means for us to have joy—a joy from him that is defiant in the face of this broken world.
Sessions include:
1) A Reason to Celebrate
2) Godly Interference
3) Greener Grass
4) Expectant Hope
5) Cultivating Joy
6) The Ultimate Victory
Designed for use with Unwavering Study Guide (ISBN 9780310096900), available at online retailers.
Group Discussion Questions

source_data.title: Resilient
source_data.body:
A ROAD MAP TO FINDING THE JOY YOU’VE LOST

The longing for joy is one of the deepest yearnings of the human heart. After times of trial—including the pandemic, economic turmoil, wars and rumors of war, and grief—our desire rises to the surface demanding relief. We’ve had to rally. Yet at some point, we have to replenish our soul’s reserves or we will burn out.

In this Resilient study series, John Eldredge provides the awareness and skills you need to strengthen your weary soul. Drawing on wisdom from Scripture, Christian tradition, and practical experiences, Resilient offers powerful supernatural graces to sustain you through these trying times as well as prepare you for future storms. 

Resilient leads you to the peace only God can give in a world gone mad—and helps you receive from Jesus the strength that prevails.

Sessions and video run times:

  • The Strength That Prevails (17:30)
  • Glory or Desolation (21:00)
  • Unconverted Places (19:30)
  • The Deep Well Inside Us (22:30)
  • Don’t Look Back (26:30)
